## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 15, 2026 - Aug 7, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Gabby_, Aug 7, 2026, 1/5: "It was great at first. Many bots to choose from, unlimited messaging, and not that weird background like other ai apps. Then, it came crashing down with the adds. LITERALLY, after every two messages there is an add. Additionally, the chat screen itself already has adds. Also, after a while, even your own chats get deleted. I wouldn't download."
            2. _AYAN KHAN_, Aug 6, 2026, 1/5: "it was all good before but then ceo decided to ruin it, made it paid only and added a lot of bugs"
            3. _April H_, Jul 27, 2026, 1/5: "as long as you can afford the subscription the app is good. if you can't then the ads get aggravating especially being at the top of chat. it makes it to where you can not see what you type after a few lines. here lately, I can chat for a few paragraphs then it stop responding. have to close app and restart it. a few more paragraphs then it quits responding. have to close and restart again. very annoying. if they would get rid of ads at the top of messages then it would be ok. need to fix bugs."
